command:
set -euo pipefail
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-ab.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-expression-eye-ab-harness-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
OUT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/expression_eye_ab_v2_20260912_1050
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then echo "FAIL_EXISTING_OUT=$OUT"; exit 3; fi
BEFORE=$(sha256sum visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'SUBJECT '; sha256sum visual/buehne.html visual/buehne_daemon.py visual/augen_blink_relief2/blink_000.png
python3 "$TMP/repo/handoff/avatar-expression-eye-ab-harness-20260912/expression_eye_ab_harness.py" --visual-root visual --out "$OUT" --port 9246
AFTER=$(sha256sum visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
o=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/expression_eye_ab_v2_20260912_1050')
r=json.loads((o/'report.json').read_text())
print('AB_SUMMARY',json.dumps({'scope':r['scope'],'native_eye_diff_pixels':r['native_to_canonical_eye']['diff_pixels'],'gaze_diff_pixels':r['canonical_eye_to_gaze']['diff_pixels'],'red_iou':r['red_mask_iou_eye_vs_gaze'],'source_mutation':r['source_mutation']},sort_keys=True))
for p in sorted(o.glob('*.png')): print('PNG',p.name,p.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY
sha256sum visual/buehne.html
